messages:
deploy-bot: Deployed release/2026.03.17 -> prod (console-frontend:1.4.7) at 2026-03-17T10:00:34Z
amanda: FYI rolling forward 1.4.7, no DB migrations, only metric field rename from PR #542
maria: Heads up — customers pinged support: p95/p99 lines on latency dashboard are gone after deploy
jon: I can reproduce. Dashboard only shows p50 and avg for the last hour, quantile traces missing entirely
sree: any errors in the metrics backend? I'm checking aggregator logs now
amanda: query that the dashboard runs: `GET /metrics/query?expr=percentile(duration_ms,95)&...` returns empty series for 95/99
jon: hitting metrics-api directly: 200 OK but payload only includes `p50` and `avg` keys
maria: quick grep of PR 542 — we changed the telemetry event schema: `duration_ms` -> `latency` (string), and the indexer mapping didn't add a numeric alias. oof
sree: that explains it. histogram/quantile agg expects numeric `duration_ms` field. If it's missing, aggregator skips p95/p99
amanda: repro steps for anyone: 1) open /console/dash/latency 2) set env=prod, service=redwood-api 3) timeframe=1h 4) observe only p50 line present
jon: logs from metric-aggregator (excerpt):
```
WARN  metric-aggregator: histogram_aggregate skipped for series id=svc.redwood-api, reason=missing field duration_ms
```
sree: starting a bisect of the build; will check which commit introduced the rename in pipeline images
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-17-001 (priority=P2) assigned to eng-releases, paging: @sree @amanda
maria: immediate mitigation: add a compatibility shim in the indexer that populates `duration_ms` from `latency` when present and numeric. I can craft a small mapping change and hot-redeploy indexer
jon: alternative short-term dashboard fallback: change queries to use `percentile(ifnull(duration_ms, to_number(latency)),95)` but that's messy and frontend-only
amanda: I pushed a shim branch: indexer-shim/compat-duration. Patch will backfill the last 2h and populate duration_ms for new events
sree: rolling the shim to indexer-prod now, will watch ingestion pipeline and aggregator logs
jon: re-run dashboard query after backfill? I can trigger a manual reindex for last 60m for affected namespaces
ops-bot: Rollout started: indexer-prod -> canary (instances=2) at 2026-03-17T10:18:00Z
sree: canary looks clean, aggregator WARNs decreased, now seeing p95 series return in query response for canary timeframe
maria: support notified customers about ongoing mitigation and ETA ~30m. cc @support to follow up once stable
support: Thanks — will update the two affected accounts (Acme Inc, Finlytics) and pause any escalation until confirmation
amanda: After full rollout and backfill, p95/p99 lines are visible again in staging -> rolling to prod finish at 2026-03-17T10:36:00Z\jon: follow-ups: add integration test that renders the latency dashboard after deploy and asserts p95/p99 series exist for synthetic traffic; add a CI job that runs a quick query smoke-test after releases that touch telemetry schema
sree: also create a runbook entry: if quantiles disappear, check: 1) telemetry schema change 2) indexer mapping 3) aggregator WARN logs for missing field
maria: opened PR for runbook + test: #578, assign amanda for review
amanda: thanks all — closing incident after 1st confirmation from support that customers see graphs again :heart:
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-17-001 marked resolved at 2026-03-17T11:02:40Z
jon: postmortem todo: root cause = schema rename without indexer compatibility, action items = tests + runbook + add telemetry-change checklist in release notes
maria: I'll draft a short postmortem and link to PRs. ETA EOD today
